title: DIY Pearl Net Bag with Pouch tutorial ✨ High-End Pearl Purse for $10! #bag #beadedfashion
description:
Elevate your style with this handmade Pearl Net Bag! 🕊️ In this video, I’m showing you how to create this trendy beaded mesh purse from scratch. It’s the perfect accessory for summer or a special occasion.

✨ Full step-by-step tutorial is already on my channel! Click the link below to watch the 9-minute detailed version. 🔗 https://youtu.be/wpVKjmyIZz4

❤️ My Instagram https://instagram.com/tatiana_diy
•♥•♥•♥•♥•♥•♥•
✂️ Materials ✂️
🔹 6mm Faux Pearl Beads (approx.800-900 pcs)
🔹 0.5mm~0.7mm Clear Nylon Beading Thread (Heavy duty)
🔹 Satin Fabric (for the drawstring pouch)
🔹 Satin Rattail Cord (for the ties)
🔹 Metal Chain Strap (optional)
